notes: Read all 131 source lines before editing. Module-level doc block L1-37 (the five web requirements + the crypto.randomUUID non-requirement rationale + the localStorage/dismissal design constraints) is ported into the native header with per-line source citations and the native adaptation reasoning. Zero imports in source -> zero imports in native output (no DOM, window, BroadcastChannel/ResizeObserver/CSS globals, Recharts, Leaflet, or web-UI).

Public + internal surface preserved name-for-name and signature-for-signature: STORAGE_KEY internal constant = 'teslasync:compat-warning-dismissed:v1' (source L39 -> native L57, byte-identical), detectMissingFeatures(): string[] (L51-88), isCompatWarningDismissed(): boolean (L96-102), dismissCompatWarning(): void (L110-116), __resetCompatWarningForTests(): void (L123-129), and the exported COMPAT_WARNING_STORAGE_KEY = STORAGE_KEY (L131). No exports added or removed.

detectMissingFeatures (source L51-88): the two genuinely cross-platform probes the native app shares with the web SPA are kept VERBATIM in structure and return string — the Intl.RelativeTimeFormat try/catch (source L62-71, incl. the `typeof Intl === 'undefined'` guard, the `(Intl as { RelativeTimeFormat?: unknown })` cast, and the catch-pushes-missing fallback) and the structuredClone probe (source L83-85, `(globalThis as { structuredClone?: unknown }).structuredClone` cast). Deterministic order Intl.RelativeTimeFormat then structuredClone is the same relative order as the source. `const missing: string[] = []` accumulator (L52) and `return missing` (L87) preserved.

Contract rule 7 — browser-only behavior given an explicit unavailable/not-applicable state: the three purely web-platform probes are intentionally NOT part of the native required-feature set because React Native has no browser to be 'too old' and the native app uses none of them — BroadcastChannel (source L54-56, cross-TAB sync; native has no sibling tabs), ResizeObserver (source L58-60, Recharts ResponsiveContainer / Leaflet sizing; not used natively), and CSS @supports / CSS :has() (source L73-81, no CSS engine on native). Reporting their expected absence on a healthy Hermes runtime would fire a FALSE 'unsupported' banner — the opposite of the source's intent — so they are excluded and each is documented with its source-line range in the native file header. Avoiding these globals also keeps the native output free of DOM-lib type dependencies.

Contract rule 7 — localStorage has no React Native analog and no AsyncStorage/web-storage dep is installed in apps/native, so the web `globalThis.localStorage?.getItem/setItem/removeItem` calls (source L98, L112, L125) are replaced by an in-process Map `nativeCompatStore` mirroring the getItem/setItem/removeItem string contract exactly — the established useSidebarStyle.ts / useChartLegendState.ts / ThemeProvider.tsx precedent. isCompatWarningDismissed compares `nativeCompatStore.get(STORAGE_KEY) === '1'` (mirrors source L98), dismissCompatWarning does `.set(STORAGE_KEY, '1')` (source L112), __resetCompatWarningForTests does `.delete(STORAGE_KEY)` (source L125). The flag round-trips within a session but does NOT survive an app restart (durable sticky-per-browser persistence is browser-only).

Defensive try/catch wrappers preserved verbatim even though the Map cannot throw, keeping the contract identical to the web: isCompatWarningDismissed catch -> return false (source L99-101), dismissCompatWarning catch -> swallow with the private-mode/quota parity comment (source L113-115), __resetCompatWarningForTests catch -> ignore comment (source L126-128). Each catch retains a comment so eslint no-empty is satisfied (block with comment is not 'empty').
crypto.randomUUID is never probed (source L11-19, L99-107, L140-151 of the web test confirm it is intentionally not a requirement); parity preserved by omitting it on native too.

No unit handling, API paths, or i18n strings exist in this source, so none to preserve. Visual intent: this helper drives a compat banner that, by design, must never false-fire — the native port keeps that intent by returning [] on a healthy runtime. Prettier (arrowParens avoid, singleQuote, trailingComma all) and @react-native eslint formatting applied.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest) — see final response for raw results.
